name: Deleting a user sends an 'account deleted' email
description:
Objective: Deleting a user sends an 'account deleted' email.
Preconditions: Open User lifecycle emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User lifecycle emails.
2. Deleting a user sends an 'account deleted' email.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Deleting a user must trigger USER_ACCOUNT_DELETED email to the deleted user's address in the configured app.
